intro.text: A number sign (#) is used with this entry because of evidence that X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 (SPGFX3) is caused by hemizygous mutation in the CFAP47 gene (301057) on chromosome Xp21.1.

checks.claim: X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 (SPGFX3) is caused by hemizygous mutation in the CFAP47 gene.
checks.evidence_quote: our experimental observations in humans and mice demonstrate that hemizygous mutations in CFAP47 can induce X-linked MMAF and asthenoteratozoospermia
checks.explanation: The paper links hemizygous CFAP47 mutations to X-linked MMAF/asthenoteratozoospermia. SPGFX3 is the OMIM name for this disorder.

checks.claim: The CFAP47 gene is located on chromosome Xp21.1.
checks.evidence_quote: permitted the identification of a hemizygous Xp21.1 deletion removing the entire CFAP47 gene
checks.explanation: The paper places CFAP47 at Xp21.1.

paragraphs.text: X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 is a form of primary male infertility caused by asthenoteratozoospermia with multiple morphological abnormalities of the sperm flagella (MMAF) (Liu et al., 2021). The disorder results from hemizygous mutation in CFAP47, which encodes a cilia- and flagella-associated protein that is highly expressed in testis (Liu et al., 2021).

checks.claim: X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 is a form of primary male infertility.
checks.evidence_quote: Deleterious variants in X-linked CFAP47 induce asthenoteratozoospermia and primary male infertility.
checks.explanation: The title describes the disorder as primary male infertility.

checks.claim: X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 is caused by asthenoteratozoospermia with multiple morphological abnormalities of the sperm flagella (MMAF).
checks.evidence_quote: Asthenoteratozoospermia characterized by multiple morphological abnormalities of the flagella (MMAF) has been identified as a sub-type of male infertility.
checks.explanation: The paper describes this infertility as asthenoteratozoospermia with MMAF.

checks.claim: X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 results from hemizygous mutation in CFAP47.
checks.evidence_quote: hemizygous mutations in CFAP47 can induce X-linked MMAF and asthenoteratozoospermia
checks.explanation: The paper attributes the disorder to hemizygous CFAP47 mutations.

checks.claim: CFAP47 encodes a cilia- and flagella-associated protein.
checks.evidence_quote: CFAP47 encodes a cilia- and flagella-associated protein that is highly expressed in testis.

checks.claim: CFAP47 is highly expressed in testis.
checks.evidence_quote: CFAP47 encodes a cilia- and flagella-associated protein that is highly expressed in testis.

paragraphs.text: Liu et al. (2021) reported 3 unrelated Chinese men with primary infertility and asthenoteratozoospermia characterized by multiple morphological abnormalities of the sperm flagella (MMAF). An Australian man with severe asthenoteratozoospermia from a second cohort was also found to carry a hemizygous CFAP47 variant. All 4 men carrying hemizygous CFAP47 variants showed typical MMAF phenotypes.

checks.claim: Liu et al. (2021) reported 3 unrelated Chinese men with primary infertility.
checks.evidence_quote: identified hemizygous missense variants in the X-linked CFAP47 in three unrelated Chinese individuals with MMAF
checks.explanation: Three unrelated Chinese men with MMAF are reported, and the title frames their condition as primary male infertility.

checks.claim: The 3 unrelated Chinese men reported by Liu et al. (2021) had asthenoteratozoospermia characterized by multiple morphological abnormalities of the sperm flagella (MMAF).
checks.evidence_quote: identified hemizygous missense variants in the X-linked CFAP47 in three unrelated Chinese individuals with MMAF
checks.explanation: The three men had MMAF, which the paper defines as a form of asthenoteratozoospermia.

checks.claim: An Australian man with severe asthenoteratozoospermia from a second cohort studied by Liu et al. (2021) carried a hemizygous CFAP47 variant.
checks.evidence_quote: WES data from an additional cohort of severe asthenoteratozoospermic men originating from Australia permitted the identification of a hemizygous Xp21.1 deletion removing the entire CFAP47 gene.
checks.explanation: The paper reports a hemizygous CFAP47 deletion in a man from the Australian cohort.

checks.claim: All 4 men carrying hemizygous CFAP47 variants reported by Liu et al. (2021) showed typical MMAF phenotypes.
checks.evidence_quote: All men harboring hemizygous CFAP47 variants displayed typical MMAF phenotypes.
checks.explanation: This covers the 3 Chinese men plus the Australian man, so 4 in total.

paragraphs.text: Liao et al. (2022) studied a man with MMAF, identified among 7 men with MMAF who were screened for gene mutations.

checks.claim: Liao et al. (2022) studied a man with MMAF.
checks.evidence_quote: CFAP47 was dramatically reduced in spermatozoa from the CFAP47-mutated man
checks.explanation: The abstract describes a man with MMAF who carried CFAP47 mutations.

checks.claim: The man with MMAF studied by Liao et al. (2022) was identified among 7 men with MMAF who were screened for gene mutations.
checks.evidence_quote: we screened gene mutations in seven MMAF individuals and found two novel mutations in CFAP47 (c.706G>A, Val236Met; c.1337C>T, Thr446Met) in one case
checks.explanation: The abstract says 'individuals', not 'men', but the case is later called a man and all were screened for sperm defects.

paragraphs.text: Liu et al. (2021) found hemizygous variants in the X-linked CFAP47 gene in affected men and concluded that hemizygous CFAP47 mutations can cause X-linked MMAF and asthenoteratozoospermia, consistent with X-linked recessive inheritance.

checks.claim: Liu et al. (2021) found hemizygous variants in the X-linked CFAP47 gene in affected men.
checks.evidence_quote: identified hemizygous missense variants in the X-linked CFAP47 in three unrelated Chinese individuals with MMAF

checks.claim: Liu et al. (2021) concluded that hemizygous CFAP47 mutations can cause X-linked MMAF and asthenoteratozoospermia.
checks.evidence_quote: hemizygous mutations in CFAP47 can induce X-linked MMAF and asthenoteratozoospermia
checks.explanation: This is the paper's stated conclusion.

checks.claim: The inheritance of CFAP47-related MMAF and asthenoteratozoospermia is consistent with X-linked recessive inheritance.
checks.evidence_quote: hemizygous mutations in CFAP47 can induce X-linked MMAF and asthenoteratozoospermia
checks.explanation: The paper says the condition is X-linked and occurs in hemizygous males. It does not use the words 'X-linked recessive'; the draft infers that.

paragraphs.text: Using whole-exome sequencing, Liu et al. (2021) identified hemizygous missense variants in the CFAP47 gene in 3 unrelated Chinese men with MMAF. None of the 3 variants appeared in human control population genome databases, and several bioinformatic tools predicted them to be deleterious. Immunoblotting and immunofluorescence showed clearly reduced CFAP47 levels in spermatozoa from all 3 men.

checks.claim: Liu et al. (2021) used whole-exome sequencing to identify hemizygous missense variants in the CFAP47 gene in 3 unrelated Chinese men with MMAF.
checks.evidence_quote: we conducted whole-exome sequencing (WES) and identified hemizygous missense variants in the X-linked CFAP47 in three unrelated Chinese individuals with MMAF

checks.claim: None of the 3 CFAP47 missense variants identified by Liu et al. (2021) in Chinese men with MMAF appeared in human control population genome databases.
checks.evidence_quote: These three CFAP47 variants were absent in human control population genome databases

checks.claim: Several bioinformatic tools predicted the 3 CFAP47 missense variants identified by Liu et al. (2021) to be deleterious.
checks.evidence_quote: were predicted to be deleterious by multiple bioinformatic tools

checks.claim: Immunoblotting and immunofluorescence showed clearly reduced CFAP47 levels in spermatozoa from all 3 Chinese men with CFAP47 missense variants reported by Liu et al. (2021).
checks.evidence_quote: Immunoblotting and immunofluorescence assays revealed obviously reduced levels of CFAP47 in spermatozoa from all three men harboring deleterious missense variants of CFAP47.
checks.explanation: The paper states this directly; 'clearly reduced' restates 'obviously reduced'.

paragraphs.text: In whole-exome sequencing data from a second cohort of Australian men with severe asthenoteratozoospermia, Liu et al. (2021) identified a man with a hemizygous deletion at Xp21.1 that removed the entire CFAP47 gene.

checks.evidence_quote: permitted the identification of a hemizygous Xp21.1 deletion removing the entire CFAP47 gene

paragraphs.text: Liao et al. (2022) screened 7 men with MMAF for gene mutations and in 1 man identified 2 novel CFAP47 mutations: val236-to-met (V236M) and thr446-to-met (T446M). Immunoblotting and immunofluorescence of spermatozoa from this man showed that CFAP47 was dramatically reduced, and that WDR87 was also significantly decreased, with weak signals near the sperm nuclei.

checks.claim: Liao et al. (2022) screened 7 men with MMAF for gene mutations.
checks.evidence_quote: we screened gene mutations in seven MMAF individuals
checks.explanation: The abstract states that 7 MMAF individuals were screened.

checks.claim: Liao et al. (2022) identified 2 novel CFAP47 mutations, V236M and T446M, in 1 man with MMAF.
checks.evidence_quote: found two novel mutations in CFAP47 (c.706G>A, Val236Met; c.1337C>T, Thr446Met) in one case
checks.explanation: Both novel mutations were found in one case.

checks.claim: Immunoblotting and immunofluorescence of spermatozoa from the man with CFAP47 V236M and T446M mutations showed that CFAP47 was dramatically reduced.
checks.evidence_quote: Immunoblotting and immunofluorescence revealed that CFAP47 was dramatically reduced in spermatozoa from the CFAP47-mutated man.

checks.claim: Immunoblotting and immunofluorescence of spermatozoa from the man with CFAP47 V236M and T446M mutations showed that WDR87 was significantly decreased.
checks.evidence_quote: Meanwhile, the expression of WDR87 was also significantly decreased

checks.claim: In spermatozoa from the man with CFAP47 V236M and T446M mutations, WDR87 showed weak signals near the sperm nuclei.
checks.evidence_quote: weak signals were detected adjacent to the spermatozoa nuclei

paragraphs.text: Liao et al. (2022) found that WDR87 is highly expressed in human and mouse testis and localizes to the middle piece of the sperm tail, where it interacts with CFAP47. They suggested that the 2 proteins form a complex involved in sperm tail assembly. Based on the reduced WDR87 signal in spermatozoa from a man with CFAP47 mutations, they concluded that CFAP47 is needed to transport WDR87 during sperm flagellum formation, and suggested that WDR87 may be associated with MMAF.

checks.claim: Liao et al. (2022) found that WDR87 is highly expressed in human and mouse testis.
checks.evidence_quote: it was highly expressed in the testis of both humans and mice

checks.claim: Liao et al. (2022) found that WDR87 localizes to the middle piece of the sperm tail.
checks.evidence_quote: WDR87 is located in the middle piece of the sperm tail

checks.claim: Liao et al. (2022) found that WDR87 interacts with CFAP47.
checks.evidence_quote: CFAP47, which interacted with WDR87 in the flagellar midpiece of the spermatozoa

checks.claim: Liao et al. (2022) suggested that WDR87 and CFAP47 form a complex involved in sperm tail assembly.
checks.evidence_quote: interacts with CFAP47 to form a complex which is involved in spermatozoa tail assembly

checks.claim: Based on reduced WDR87 signal in spermatozoa from a man with CFAP47 mutations, Liao et al. (2022) concluded that CFAP47 is needed to transport WDR87 during sperm flagellum formation.
checks.evidence_quote: weak signals were detected adjacent to the spermatozoa nuclei, indicating that CFAP47 was necessary for WDR87 transportation during spermatozoa flagella biogenesis
checks.explanation: The abstract draws this conclusion from the reduced WDR87 signal.

checks.claim: Liao et al. (2022) suggested that WDR87 may be associated with MMAF.
checks.evidence_quote: suggesting that WDR87 may be associated with multiple morphological abnormalities of the flagella (MMAF)

paragraphs.text: On the basis of their human and mouse findings, including rescue of fertility in Cfap47-mutant male mice by intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI), Liu et al. (2021) suggested a good prognosis with ICSI for men with hemizygous CFAP47 mutations.

checks.evidence_quote: the adult males of which were sterile and presented with reduced sperm motility and abnormal flagellar morphology and movement. However, fertility could be rescued by the use of intra-cytoplasmic sperm injections (ICSIs).
checks.explanation: The ICSI rescue was shown in the mutant mice.

checks.claim: Liu et al. (2021) suggested a good prognosis with ICSI for men with hemizygous CFAP47 mutations.
checks.evidence_quote: hemizygous mutations in CFAP47 can induce X-linked MMAF and asthenoteratozoospermia, for which good ICSI prognosis is suggested

paragraphs.text: Liu et al. (2021) generated a Cfap47-mutated mouse model. Adult male mutant mice were sterile and had reduced sperm motility and abnormal flagellar shape and movement. Their fertility could be rescued by ICSI.

paragraphs.text: In whole-exome sequencing data from a cohort of Australian men with severe asthenoteratozoospermia, Liu et al. (2021) identified a man with a hemizygous deletion at Xp21.1 that removed the entire CFAP47 gene. He showed a typical MMAF phenotype.

paragraphs.text: In a man with MMAF, Liao et al. (2022) identified a c.706G-A transition in the CFAP47 gene, resulting in a val236-to-met (V236M) substitution, together with a second CFAP47 mutation (T446M). Immunoblotting and immunofluorescence showed dramatically reduced CFAP47 and significantly decreased WDR87 in his spermatozoa.
